cancellation.content: func TestCancellationProbe(t *testing.T) { root := os.Getenv("SEMIO_GO_CANCELLATION_ROOT"); if root == "" { t.Skip("cancellation probe inactive") }; if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "ready"), []byte(strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid())), 0o644); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; for tick := 0; ; tick++ { if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "ticks"), []byte(strconv.Itoa(tick)), 0o644); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond) } }
